column1: # Cycle times measured on real machines, to compare the estimate (cam.h estimateCycleTime) with (task T-059; filled in
# M8). tests/unit/cam/cycletime_test.cpp "cycle time against times measured on real machines" reads this file: it
# estimates every record, prints the error, and fails a record whose error is above the record's own limit. While the
# file has no records the test is skipped.
# FORMAT. UTF-8 text. Lines starting with # and empty lines are ignored. One record per line, six fields separated by
#   1 program      the setup's toolpaths in program order: RCTP files (cam.h Toolpath::serialize, the golden toolpath
#                  format; raycad-cli writes them), comma-separated, relative to this folder
#   2 machine      the machine definition the program ran on, a library machine file (lib::toJson, *.machine.json),
#                  relative to this folder; it should carry the machine's real rapid rates, feeds, accelerations and
#                  tool change time where they are known
#   3 tools        the tool number of each toolpath (cam.h ToolRef::toolNumber), comma-separated, as many as in field 1
#   4 measured     the measured time in seconds, from cycle start to the end of the program (M30), with 100 % rapid,
#   5 max error    the error allowed for this record, in percent of the measured time; the test fails above it
#   6 source       free text: the machine and control, its settings that change motion (smoothing or look-ahead mode,
#                  exact stop), how the time was taken (the control's cycle timer, a stopwatch) and the date
